## Type

## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm run check` passes (build, typecheck, test, validate, size)
- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] Docs updated (and `pnpm docs:llms` re-run if docs changed)
- [ ] Every new button or slider has an accessible name and works with the keyboard
- [ ] `destroy()` removes everything this change adds (listeners, timers, DOM)
- [ ] No third-party trademarks or assets
